breakthrough: AI collaboration feels like working beside a capable teammate
lane: Human-agent work execution and shared workspaces
outcome: Let humans and agents manipulate the same tasks, files, decisions, and live artifacts

phases.name: Phase 1 - Build the Human Agent Cowork Core

subphases.name: 1.1 Human Agent Cowork Domain Model and State Plane
work: Define typed workspaces, blocks, links, commands, and execution state required to let humans and agents manipulate the same tasks, files, decisions, and live artifacts, with explicit versions and validation at every boundary.

Implement an owned persistent state layer optimized for goals, missions, human attention, agent teamwork, skill development, and measurable outcomes; include snapshots or event history when state changes over time.
Expose create, query, update, subscribe, and delete operations through local APIs plus an SDK that never requires private cross-runtime imports.

subphases.name: 1.2 Human Agent Cowork Execution Runtime
work: Build resumable workers and state machines that perform the core operation: let humans and agents manipulate the same tasks, files, decisions, and live artifacts.
Add cancellation, idempotency, bounded retries, timeouts, quotas, sandbox limits, and deterministic recovery from partial failure.
Create a local simulator that can replay success, malformed inputs, disconnection, overload, provider loss, and restart recovery.

phases.name: Phase 2 - Make Human Agent Cowork Adaptive and Usable

subphases.name: 2.1 Human Agent Cowork Decision and Learning Engine
work: Implement scoring, planning, prediction, search, or optimization using planning graphs, skill matching, mixed-initiative control, simulation, and workload optimization.
Create feedback signals from task outcomes and user corrections; update tunable behavior without silently changing hard safety limits.
Return confidence, alternatives, bottlenecks, and a concise machine-readable explanation for every important automated choice.

subphases.name: 2.2 Human Agent Cowork Interaction Surface
work: Build the primary experience in the collaborative mission canvas, focus mode, presence map, and work-cell console, including live state, controls, errors, and recovery actions.
Add a CLI and typed client library so humans, agents, games, and third-party applications can operate the capability directly.
Stream progress and intermediate artifacts in real time so long operations remain inspectable, interruptible, and steerable.

phases.name: Phase 3 - Scale Human Agent Cowork into a Breakthrough Product

subphases.name: 3.1 Human Agent Cowork Offline, Edge, and Cloud Mesh
work: Implement local-only, hybrid, and cloud execution with explicit capability discovery and graceful behavior when optional peers disappear.
Add conflict-safe synchronization, workload placement, caching, backpressure, and failover across devices or nodes where the feature benefits from distribution.
Benchmark latency, throughput, memory, energy, network transfer, and cost; make the scheduler choose the best execution mode from measured constraints.

subphases.name: 3.2 Human Agent Cowork Signature Breakthrough
work: Implement the differentiating behavior: AI collaboration feels like working beside a capable teammate. Ship it as an opt-in executable mode, not a mockup.
Run adversarial, load, privacy, misuse, degraded-network, and recovery tests against the novel behavior; block unsafe automatic actions.
Package the feature as an independently installable capability with a live demo, sample integration, metrics endpoint, and rollback-safe release artifact.
